verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists analytics-related features like 'CX Score, AI Topics, Trends, AI Recommendations, Monitors, Custom AI Scorecards, Incident Detection' (intercom-fin-docs-16), hinting at some reporting/dashboard capability, but there is no evidence describing a dashboard that surfaces resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, or cost per resolution specifically for exec reporting. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard showing resolution rate, CSAT score tracking, handoff rate metric, cost-per-resolution calculation, and any exec-reporting export/view of these combined metrics.
